title: Multimodal Image Analysis and Guidance of Neuromodulation for Trauma-Related Symptoms
official: Multimodal Image Analysis and Guidance of Neuromodulation for Trauma-Related Symptoms
summary: MAGNETS is a prospective, randomized, parallel-design, sham-controlled clinical trial of accelerated, functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI)-guided intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) to the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) for chronic symptoms of posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) in a comorbid Veteran population.

sites.f: New Mexico VA Health Care System
